name: Wondersearch
long_description:
Our mission is to give every AI agent the right context, from any amount of data.

WonderSearch is search built for AI agents. We let developers make all of their data searchable by meaning, without embeddings, servers or ingestion, so agents can pull the right context and cite where it came from. Unlike vector databases and RAG stacks, there's no pipeline to build or maintain: connect your files and data, and they're searchable right away. It runs on our own search model, and you pay only per query, whatever the size of your data.

Teams use WonderSearch across their own documents and knowledge, and build it into their products, help centres and AI features, connecting through MCP, our API, the CLI or the Python SDK.

(Evokoa, Inc. is the company behind WonderSearch.)
one_liner: Instant semantic search over your data without embeddings.
